source_observations: AgentExit implements intrinsic early exit as prompt text that asks the same acting model to emit EXIT when the environment appears complete or further progress seems unlikely.
Its extrinsic path instantiates a Verify helper using the same llm_model and periodically asks it to judge recent history for stuckness, completion, infeasibility or low expected progress.
Verify latches exit_flag when the free-form verifier response contains the substring YES; this is not a typed or schema-validated decision surface.
When exit_flag is latched, ReactStyleAgentVerify returns action EXIT before the next environment action.

In the audited ALFWorld task loop, any action containing EXIT breaks the interaction with exit_reason=early_exit before env.step; success remains a separate environment-derived done signal. Thus EXIT is control-flow termination in this path, not itself success evidence.

The repository exposes task progress trajectories and baseline comparison infrastructure, supporting the paper's general redundancy-versus-progress-loss framing, but this E1 audit did not locate a repository implementation that independently establishes the paper's exact Redundancy Steps and Progress Degradation formulas. Exact metric reproduction therefore remains unproven here.

ReactStyleAgentHistory replays a prior trajectory until the recorded early-exit point and then resumes generation, demonstrating continuation/handoff as a concept but carrying history as AgentBoard-specific trajectory data rather than a typed causal F2 envelope.

The executable package is tightly coupled to AgentBoard environments, task-specific EXIT modifications, model-provider wrappers, logging/baseline infrastructure and optional W&B; importing it wholesale would add a large dependency and authority surface for a narrow WP509 need.
The audited tree contains a tracked .env path. Its contents were intentionally not read or copied; this is a source-hygiene warning, not evidence of a leaked secret.
Apache-2.0 licensing permits donor inspection/reuse subject to license obligations, but licensing does not imply architecture suitability.
hypothesis_update: SUPPORTED_AT_SOURCE_LEVEL: separating early-stop efficiency from progress damage and allowing a bounded continuation/handoff after stopping are useful WP509 design patterns. The safest F2 translation is an advisory typed StopCandidate that proposes HOLD/WAIT/ASK/DELEGATE/REOBSERVE/STOP_COGNITION while canonical COMPLETE remains separately evidence-gated.
counterhypothesis_update: STRENGTHENED: AgentExit's same-model verifier, free-form YES substring parser and direct EXIT latch are too circular and brittle to import as F2 authority. A deterministic repeated-state/no-new-evidence/hard-budget baseline may capture most benefit with lower latency, fewer self-judgment errors and cleaner causal attribution.

distilled_f2_candidate.name: WP509_STOP_CANDIDATE_ENVELOPE_HYPOTHESIS
distilled_f2_candidate.forbidden_promotion: StopCandidate must never mint COMPLETE, effect success or world truth.
distilled_f2_candidate.implementation_preference: F2-native thin deterministic gate first; optional model verifier later only as advisory evidence. Do not embed AgentBoard as the WP509 control plane.

measurement_translation.redundancy_metric: Count transitions after the last measurable progress/evidence delta only when they also add no admitted evidence and repeat an equivalent state/action class; do not label negative evidence as redundant merely because task progress is flat.
measurement_translation.progress_degradation_metric: On paired deterministic fixtures, compare progress achieved by the stop policy against a bound reference trajectory and clamp only positive loss; bind baseline identity explicitly.

non_inference_boundaries: README and paper-reported benchmark gains are upstream claims, not F2 measurements.
This audit does not establish exact Redundancy Steps or Progress Degradation code reproduction from the repository.
A same-model verifier response is candidate cognition, not completion truth.
An EXIT/HOLD decision is not canonical task completion.
No external provider, VPS, production host or paid execution was used.
No runtime experiment or F2 ablation was executed.
No E2, E3, E4, E5 or E6 promotion is granted by this result.
No whole-F2, EntityOS/HCU, physical GRID10, canonical semantics or training credit is granted.

design_comparison: A: deterministic hard budget + repeated-state + no-new-evidence baseline
B: A plus F2-native progress-aware StopCandidate modeled on AgentExit's paired efficiency/damage framing
C: B plus bounded adaptive thresholding only after B is causally measurable
acceptance_requirements: COMPLETE authority remains unreachable from the stop controller
negative evidence is not misclassified as no progress
B reduces redundant transitions without material progress degradation versus A/reference
ASK/DELEGATE/REOBSERVE can recover useful progress after an early stop
latency/resource overhead is lower than the saved work at the evaluated workload
recommended_next_discriminator.promotion_gate: Claim E2 only after mapping this thin envelope into exact current F2 WP509/WP505/WP600-603 interfaces. Claim E3 only for a deterministic fixture. E4 requires an admitted F2 ablation surface; E6 remains Trigger-4-only.
